Name: Clinic folder number
Description: Primary Sankofa EHR medical record number. Auto-generated: 3-letter clinic prefix + 6-digit sequence + Luhn Mod-30 check digit. Prefix letters must come from the Mod-30 alphabet (no B I O Q S Z).

Name: Ghana Card PIN
Description: National Identification Authority PIN. Prefix is the ICAO nationality code (GHA for citizens; other codes for resident non-citizens). Format-only validation - NIA does not publish the check-digit algorithm. Optional; stored with patient consent (Act 843).

Name: NHIS membership number
Description: National Health Insurance Scheme membership number. 8-digit format is PROVISIONAL - verify against a current NHIA card before pilot. Patients may present a linked Ghana Card instead (*929# linkage).

Name: Legacy folder number
Description: Pre-EMR paper folder number carried over at import so historical folders stay findable. Free text.
